Rust engine deferred by human decision; Phase 1 is PySpark-only. Profile spec stays engine-neutral so a Rust (Polars/DataFusion) binary can be added later.

Merge policy (human decision): polly merges PRs that pass cross-vendor review (and, for RSI proposals, the benchmark gate) into feat/profiler-rsi on ghanse/dbldatagen. Upstream is never touched; the human reviews the branch and log before upstreaming.

Human request: PII detection and substitution with statistical preservation and relational integrity. Design: detection fills spec 0.2.0 ColumnProfile.semantic (pii_class, sensitivity taxonomy matching the catalog, confidence, value-free evidence) plus quasi-identifier sets; substitution replaces real values with keyed HMAC surrogates per (domain, value), so equality, frequencies, distinct counts, joins, and FK coverage/fan-out are preserved exactly; FK-linked columns share a domain; injective with deterministic collision resolution; class-valid formats; DOB keyed date shift; QIs unchanged by default with opt-in generalization. No new dependencies. Benchmark-side metrics deferred to P2.2 after P1.5.

P2.1 PII detection + substitution merged via https://github.com/ghanse/dbldatagen/pull/13 (head f4dfdd6, merge 88d4a5e). Spec 0.2.0 (additive): ColumnProfile.semantic (pii_class, sensitivity, confidence, value-free evidence) + quasi_identifier_sets; direct_identifier/secret columns carry no literal stats. Substitution: keyed HMAC per (domain, value), FK-linked columns (incl. composite and nested) share a domain, whole-domain injective and original-disjoint collision resolution, class-valid surrogates (Luhn, mod-97, SSN, email, IP, phone keeping country+NANP area code), entity-keyed DOB shift, free-text span replacement, QIs unchanged by default. Cross-review (cursor): 3 rounds. polly required test expansion 8 -> 66 PII cases, which exposed 7 bugs. Known gaps: names/addresses in free text, value length preserved, US-centric SSN/NANP, nested broadcast capped at 100k values (fails closed).

P1.5 fidelity, structure-recovery, and privacy metrics merged via https://github.com/ghanse/dbldatagen/pull/10 (head 8d36949, merge 0dafca7). Reconstruction (marginals, nulls, distinct, declared+random dependence incl. derived string and value-agreement features, constraints/FDs, keys, FK fan-out, HistGradientBoosting discriminator), structure recovery (F1; unplanted claims verified against real data, value-free detail), privacy hard guard (copy/DCR/partial copy vs holdout, QI sets, k audit, allowlisted regex dialect, closed profile strings, all-sensitive-rows scan with language-size threshold max(k,1e6) under a shared work budget). Ceiling = two sample seeds at one structure seed (tier s: 0.94-0.997). Cross-review (codex): 12 rounds. Threat model: accidental and optimizer-rewarded leakage; covert numeric encoding out of scope. polly gate run caught an out-of-scope spec-example edit that broke a sampler test before merge.

Finding (explore by codex at ee7efed): numeric privacy failure is a REAL leak in the reference sampler, not the metric or catalog. Only measurements.partial_copy_rate_excess fails: sampler models numeric columns as clipped normal; np.clip piles draws onto the profile's exact observed min/max (pareto/lognormal), and pairing that literal with discrete columns recreates real-unique pairs (xs 4.5-8.7%, s up to 18.7% vs 0% holdout). Fails at tiers xs and s. Fix owned by sampler: never emit exact observed extrema (truncated/resampled draws). Metric and catalog unchanged. Blocks P1.8 baseline freeze.

P1.4b sampler extrema leak fix merged via https://github.com/ghanse/dbldatagen/pull/15 (head f57d874, merge de8b432). Truncated normal (far-tail stable, inverse-CDF so copula uniforms preserved) replaces clipping; exact Decimal/int mapping. numeric partial_copy_rate_excess 4.5-18.7% -> 0.0% at xs and s, both seeds. Cross-review (codex): 5 rounds. Merged over a remaining codex finding, by polly decision: NumericStats.mean/stddev are floats in spec 0.2.0, so high-magnitude (~1e28) asymmetric exact columns lose location precision in the profile itself; not sampler-fixable. Filed as spec 0.3 candidate (lossless mean/stddev for exact types) for the RSI backlog.

Investigation (claude_code, explore-rsi-privacy-structure): both candidate privacy failures are real candidate defects, not metric artifacts (real-vs-real passes every failing check on the same pairs). rsi-0002: 7-point quantile grid spreads 10% mass over [q90,max] for Poisson ints, inflating rare real-unique (null float, tail int) pairs ~100x. rsi-0003: Gaussian copula on near-deterministic (order_date, ship_date) r=0.99998 over-disperses the lag (some negative), inflating rare long-lag pairs. rsi-0003 structure regression is mostly a HARNESS BUG: claims.Verifier.dependency projects to two columns before bounded(), whose content hash then keeps/drops identical value pairs together, biasing Pearson (e.g. claimed 0.844 true 0.845 measured 0.919). Edge's single false claim not reproduced.

Discriminator AUC=1.0 on string-heavy tables explained (cursor, explore-discriminator-features-r2): driven by zero vocabulary overlap on LOW-cardinality categoricals (country, region, category, status, tier, device.os, ...), because the baseline emits no string top_values so the sampler invents labels. That is a real profile gap (rsi-0009 fixes it), not a measurement artefact; keep categorical identity. High-cardinality strings (email, sku, uuid, names, free text) are only weak separators but identity-coding them is noise no privacy-safe profile can match. Decision: fold into P1.6e before merge: drop the top-K identity index for high-cardinality string features (keep length/charset/#format/frequency-rank shape features); plus reviewer hardening (saturated-before-improved in the targeted gate; tests for targeted inconclusive/insufficient).

Human decision: streaming parity and a streaming check in the benchmark are long-term follow-ups, not scheduled. Gap recorded: streaming lacks quantiles/histograms (rsi-0002b), Pearson (rsi-0003b) and, once merged, patterns (rsi-0001), top_values (rsi-0009) and Cramer's V (rsi-0011); only rsi-0010 length stddev reached streaming. Exactly mergeable first (cross-moments, histogram and contingency counts, shape counts); quantiles and top_values need sketches (KLL/t-digest, frequent items) with k rules re-checked on merged counts. Benchmark doesn't score streaming.

summary: P1.6e discriminator-first gate merged via https://github.com/ghanse/dbldatagen/pull/46 (head 52ac69e, merge 33cb62b): policy 3.0.0, metrics 2.1.0. Log-loss gap (r - nll)/r, r = min(ceiling nll, ln 2), clipped [0,1]; key/unique/FK/monotone/auto-ID columns excluded from discriminator features (manifest + real schema, never the candidate); entity-grouped train/test split; cross-table FK-joined discriminator; high-cardinality strings encoded by shape only, low-cardinality categoricals keep identity; gate = global improvement OR >=1 target, with privacy, keys/FK/constraints, per-dataset gap and composite guards; real holdout and screen covered. Real-vs-real AUC 0.46-0.51 on all 10 datasets. Cross-review (cursor): 2 rounds. polly gates: profiler 424; bench 669 passed when run alone (two earlier runs failed with Spark Connection refused cascades under concurrent suites). Bench suite now takes ~71 min alone.

Human decision: improve discriminator AUC first; later, accept changes that significantly improve the composite without significant discriminator impact. Proposed rule (to implement as a logged benchmark change once datasets leave saturation): per dataset, the composite path opens only when its baseline discriminator AUC <= 0.75 (gap no longer saturated); there, a proposal may pass if the composite improves >= 0.01 with paired CI > 0 on a declared target AND the discriminator gap worsens by no more than the measured noise floor (0.005) on any dataset, with all existing guards. Thresholds to be calibrated from the policy-3 baseline seed spread. Until then the gate stays discriminator-only.

Human decision: prioritize separability. Phase 1 = proposals expected to lower discriminator AUC/log-loss gap; Phase 2 (after AUC leaves saturation, with P1.6h) = composite fine-tuning. Effects: rsi-0012 (key/FK discovery, mostly keys/foreign_keys composite) paused and cancelled before code; rsi-0001, rsi-0003c, rsi-0010, rsi-0011 (approved, composite-focused) parked, not benchmarked, to be rebased and revisited in Phase 2; rsi-0009 (category labels) is the Phase-1 lead; rsi-0002c continues as an independent speed change. Next: an evidence-driven round of separability proposals from per-feature discriminator analysis with rsi-0009 applied.
